REPLACE:liberum_veto = {
	content_priority = 900
	estate = nobles_estate
		
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ } # Project Phoenix uses its own privileges.

		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = POL
			has_or_had_tag = PLC
		}
		has_variable = unlock_liberum_veto_variable
	}
	can_revoke = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = plc_strive_for_reform }
			}
			"estate_power(estate_type:crown_estate)" >= 0.7
		}
	}
	
	country_modifier = {
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = medium_privilege_target_satisfaction
		global_nobles_estate_power = 5.0
		monthly_political_influence_gain_modifier = -0.20
		nobles_estate_agenda_impact = 0.25
		parliament_request_issue_support_needed = 0.2
		monthly_towards_aristocracy = societal_value_large_monthly_move
	}

	on_activate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_modifier = plc_blackmail_of_the_nobles
			}
			remove_country_modifier = plc_blackmail_of_the_nobles
		}
	}
}

		}

			}
		}

		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = medium_privilege_target_satisfaction
		global_pop_promotion_speed_modifier = -0.20

REPLACE:apostolic_tax_privilege = {
	estate = clergy_estate

	potential = {
		NOT = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ } # Project Phoenix uses its own privileges.

		religion = religion:catholic
		NOT = { tag = PAP }
	}

	on_activate = {
		add_opinion = { 
			target = c:PAP 
			modifier = opinion_accepted_apostolic_tax 
		}
		reverse_add_opinion = { 
			target = c:PAP 
			modifier = opinion_accepted_apostolic_tax 
		}
	}
	on_deactivate = {
		remove_opinion = { 
			target = c:PAP 
			modifier = opinion_accepted_apostolic_tax 
		}
		c:PAP = { 
			remove_opinion = { 
				target = prev 
				modifier = opinion_accepted_apostolic_tax 
			}
		}
	}
	
	country_modifier = {
		clergy_estate_target_satisfaction = small_privilege_target_satisfaction
		global_clergy_estate_power = 0.1
	}
}

REPLACE:jewish_ghetto_ordinance = {

	potential = {
		NOT = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ } # Project Phoenix uses its own privileges.

		}
	}
	country_modifier = {
		clergy_estate_target_satisfaction = medium_privilege_target_satisfaction
		global_clergy_estate_power = 0.25
		monthly_towards_communalism = societal_value_minor_monthly_move

REPLACE:peasants_free_peasantry = {
	estate = peasants_estate

	potential = {
		NOT = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ } # Project Phoenix uses its own privileges.

	}
	allow = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:statutes_of_piotrkow }
			NOT = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:statutes_of_piotrkow }
		}
		NOT = {	has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:ordinance_of_laborers }
	}
	
	can_revoke = {
		NOT = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:land_owning_farmers }
	}

	country_modifier = {
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = medium_privilege_target_satisfaction
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = medium_privilege_target_satisfaction_penalty
		global_peasants_migration_allowed = yes
		global_laborers_migration_allowed = yes
		global_peasants_estate_power = 0.5
		global_peasant_enfranchisment = 0.1
		peasants_estate_allowed_to_build_rgo = yes
		monthly_towards_free_subjects = societal_value_monthly_move
	}
}

REPLACE:peasants_represented_in_parliament = {
	estate = peasants_estate

	potential = {
		NOT = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ } # Project Phoenix uses its own privileges.

		modifier:has_a_parliamentary_system = yes
	}
	allow = {
		OR = {
			parliament_type = parliament_type:estate_parliament
			parliament_type = parliament_type:autocratic_parliament
			parliament_type = parliament_type:constitutional_parliament
		}
	}
	
	can_revoke = {
		NOT = { has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:land_owning_farmers }
	}
	
	country_modifier = {
